Shortcuts.Fixed.zh: 此操作使用固定交互键。

Shortcuts.RecordHint.zh: 请按快捷键；Esc 取消录制。
Shortcuts.RecordHint.en: Press a shortcut; Esc cancels recording.

Shortcuts.Imported.zh: 已载入预览；保存后生效。
Shortcuts.Imported.en: Loaded for review; save to apply.

Shortcuts.ConfigureCommands.zh: 编辑工具与命令快捷键

Shortcuts.GlobalHint.zh: 聚焦后按组合键录制；Backspace 清空。Ctrl+Alt+Esc 为固定紧急释放键。
Shortcuts.GlobalHint.en: Focus a field and press a shortcut; Backspace clears it. Ctrl+Alt+Esc always releases input.

Shortcuts.Global.Keyboard.zh: 暂停/恢复键盘演示采集

Shortcuts.Global.HideAll.zh: 临时隐藏/恢复全部覆盖内容

Shortcuts.SpaceReserved.zh: Space 用于临时平移，带修饰键的 Space 保留给系统及输入法。请选择其他按键组合。
Shortcuts.SpaceReserved.en: Space pans the view. Modified Space combinations are reserved for system and input method use. Choose another shortcut.

Shortcuts.BindingConflict.zh: {0}的 {1} 已被「{2}」占用，请重新绑定。
Shortcuts.BindingConflict.en: {1} for {0} is used by {2}. Choose another shortcut.

Shortcuts.BindingUnavailable.zh: 「{0}」的旧绑定无法使用，请在此检查并重新绑定。
Shortcuts.BindingUnavailable.en: An old binding for {0} is unavailable. Review its shortcuts here.

Shortcuts.PointerGestures.zh:
## 选择工具的鼠标手势

- Ctrl+单击选取组内叶子图层。Ctrl+Shift+单击增减叶子选择。
- Alt+拖动对象复制。按住 Alt 拖动缩放手柄，以中心为支点。
Shortcuts.PointerGestures.en:
## Mouse gestures in Select

- Ctrl+click selects a leaf inside a group. Ctrl+Shift+click adds or removes a leaf.
- Alt+drag an object to duplicate it. Alt+drag a resize handle to resize from the center.

Shortcuts.TableSearch.zh: 搜索命令、按键或生效条件

Shortcuts.KeyboardPreviewHint.zh: 高亮表示有绑定，可切换修饰键查看组合。
Shortcuts.KeyboardPreviewHint.en: Highlighted keys have bindings. Toggle modifiers to see combinations.

Shortcuts.KeyboardPreviewSelect.zh: 点击键帽查看命令及生效条件。
Shortcuts.KeyboardPreviewSelect.en: Select a key to see its commands and conditions.

Shortcuts.FindKeyHint.zh: 按下要查找的组合键，或按 Esc 结束查找。
Shortcuts.FindKeyHint.en: Press a chord to find it, or press Esc to stop.

Shortcuts.When.NumericSlider.zh: 可编辑的数值滑轨有焦点时
Shortcuts.When.NumericSlider.en: When an editable numeric slider has focus

Shortcuts.When.ToolOptions.zh: 当前工具有参数时；印章放置使用印章库和槽位
Shortcuts.When.ToolOptions.en: When the current tool has options; stamp placement uses the library and slots

Shortcuts.When.ClearCanvas.zh: 当前画布有内容且可编辑时；长按不连发
Shortcuts.When.ClearCanvas.en: With content on an editable canvas; does not repeat while held

Shortcuts.StampPlacementNoOptions.zh: 印章放置没有独立参数。请使用印章库或工具栏槽位。
Shortcuts.StampPlacementNoOptions.en: Stamp placement uses the Stamp library and toolbar slots.

Shortcuts.When.File.zh: 编辑模式；部分或全部绑定也可在文本字段中使用
Shortcuts.When.File.en: Editing mode; some or all bindings also work in text fields

Shortcuts.When.ViewNavigation.zh: 画布可见、无绘制或校准手势，且未使用鼠标演示工具时
Shortcuts.When.ViewNavigation.en: With the canvas visible, no drawing or calibration gesture, and the pointer presentation tool inactive

Shortcuts.When.Cancel.zh: 先取消当前局部操作，逐级退回穿透
Shortcuts.When.Cancel.en: Cancels the current action first, then backs out to pass-through

Shortcuts.When.Pan.zh: 按住，再用左键拖动画布
Shortcuts.When.Pan.en: Hold while dragging the canvas with the left button

Shortcuts.When.PolygonOrCalibration.zh: 多边形截图或透视四线采样时
Shortcuts.When.PolygonOrCalibration.en: During a polygon capture or four-line calibration

Shortcuts.When.Polygon.zh: 多边形截图选区尚未完成时
Shortcuts.When.Polygon.en: While drawing a polygon capture region

Shortcuts.When.CanvasOpacity.zh: 当前画布允许调整不透明度时
Shortcuts.When.CanvasOpacity.en: When the current canvas allows opacity changes

Shortcuts.When.RenameLayer.zh: 选中一个图层、组合或共享实例时
Shortcuts.When.RenameLayer.en: With one layer, group, or shared instance selected

Shortcuts.When.Selected.en: With a visible canvas and an active selection

Shortcuts.When.EditableSelection.zh: 有可执行此操作的可编辑选择时
Shortcuts.When.EditableSelection.en: With an editable selection eligible for this action

Shortcuts.When.SelectedGroup.en: With a group that can be ungrouped selected

Shortcuts.When.Undo.zh: 有可撤销的操作时，每按一次撤销一步
Shortcuts.When.Undo.en: With undo history; one step per press

Shortcuts.When.Redo.zh: 有可重做的操作时，每按一次重做一步
Shortcuts.When.Redo.en: With redo history; one step per press

Shortcuts.When.Crop.zh: 只选中一张可裁剪的图片时

Shortcuts.When.Move.zh: 有可移动的选择时，长按可连续移动
Shortcuts.When.Move.en: With a movable selection; hold to repeat

Shortcuts.When.StampSlot.zh: 对应工具栏槽位已有印章时
Shortcuts.When.StampSlot.en: When the corresponding toolbar slot holds a stamp

Shortcuts.When.LayerGroup.zh: 焦点在图层列表且选中可进入的组合时
Shortcuts.When.LayerGroup.en: When the layer list has focus and the selected group can be entered

Shortcuts.When.LayerList.en: When the layer list has focus

Shortcuts.When.StampLibrary.en: When the Stamp library has focus

Shortcuts.When.StampList.zh: 焦点在印章列表且有可用的选中项时
Shortcuts.When.StampList.en: With the stamp list focused and an eligible stamp selected

Shortcuts.When.SelectTool.zh: 选择或临时选择工具中

Shortcuts.When.ResizeHandle.zh: 拖动对象的缩放手柄时
Shortcuts.When.ResizeHandle.en: While dragging a selection resize handle

Shortcuts.DeepSelect.en: Select a leaf inside a group

Shortcuts.CrossLevelSelect.en: Add or remove leaves across groups

Shortcuts.PreviousEntries.zh:
## 从旧版升级

- 工具参数和印章库的当前绑定见上表。
- 单向箭头、双向箭头、圆角矩形和三角形可以在线条、矩形或符号的工具预设中选择。
- 清空画布可通过菜单或命令搜索执行，也可以在快捷键设置中自行绑定。
Shortcuts.PreviousEntries.en:
## Upgrading from an earlier version

- See the table for current shortcuts for Tool options and the Stamp library.
- Choose the arrow, double arrow, rounded rectangle and triangle in the Line, Rectangle or Symbol tool presets.
- Clear canvas is available in the menu and command search. You can assign a shortcut in Settings.

Shortcuts.Scope.zh: 编辑模式命令。文字输入、输入法、列表和模态窗口优先使用自己的按键。全局快捷键在设置主页单独配置。
Shortcuts.Scope.en: Editing commands. Text, IME, lists and modal windows retain their local keys. Configure global shortcuts separately in Settings.

Shortcuts.GestureOnly.zh: 此按键只在对应的画布手势中使用，不能从命令列表直接执行。
Shortcuts.GestureOnly.en: This key belongs to its canvas gesture and cannot be run from the command list.
